text_block_list.text:
Aiming to run in the Classic races, the 
days continued with training and races to 
build up her strength.

Making the most of her traits, the first 
Classic race to aim for is the Satsuki 
Sho.
choice_data_list:
(Still, suddenly standing on such a grand 
stage is...)

text_block_list.text:
"Before that, we should enter a slightly 
bigger race to build up some experience 
first. Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The Yayoi Sho, is it?

"The Yayoi Sho takes place at Nakayama 
Racecourse, just like the Satsuki Sho. 
It's the perfect race to get accustomed to 
the track."
choice_data_list: As a trial race for the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Understood. As long as I can run in fast 
races, I don't really have any 
preference...

And so, running in the Yayoi Sho was 
decided.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off for one more lap.

Days of striving to build a more robust 
stamina continued—until one day.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... would you like to go mountain 
climbing?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Mountain climbing also builds up stamina. 
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So, if you'd like, Trainer, would you 
like to climb it together with me?"

At her recommendation, I had come out to 
the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ... No, since I'm already here, I'll wait.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This feels rather refreshing. Usually, 
it's just me running by myself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...At times like this, should I be 
cheering them up...?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: D-Do your best...

—Afterwards, thanks in part to her 
encouragement, we somehow managed to reach 
the summit.

The view from the mountain peak was 
breathtaking.

The blue of the sky stands out against the 
deep green, and on the distant ridges, 
snow faintly glistens.

Glancing to the side, I saw Silence Suzuka 
also gazing entranced at the view from the 
mountaintop.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Sometimes, as part of training. In 
spring you can see cherry blossoms, and in 
autumn the foliage."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But most of all, I love the mountains in 
this season.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In the cold air... there was the scent of 
soil.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Climbing up the cramped slope and bursting 
out here... To think this spectacle would 
be waiting at that moment...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm just glad I managed to reach it.
choice_data_list: ...It's just like a race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Now that you mention it, that might be 
true.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So... for some reason, I just really 
wanted to share this view with you, 
Trainer."
choice_data_list: I felt 'glad we made it' too.
I also thought, "I'm glad I made it here."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ... You too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so?

As she offered a modest smile, I felt like 
we had grown just a little bit closer.
